description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje objekti ekzistues 4 katesh tek Rruga Bardhyl.
Apartamenti ka Sipërfaqe 58m2 neto, i organizuar ne Ambjentin e ndenjes, dy dhoma gjumi, koridor, tualeti me dritare, ballkoni.
Apartamenti eshte i sapo restauruar dhe eshte ideal per nje familje.
Prona disponon Certificate Pronesie.
Cmimi i Apartamentit eshte 148,000€.
title_en: Apartment 2+1 for sale on Bardhyl Street
description_en: The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an existing 4-storey building on Bardhyl Street. The apartment has a net area of ​​58m2, organized in the living room, two bedrooms, corridor, toilet with window, balcony. The apartment is newly restored and is ideal for a family. The property has a Certificate of Ownership. The price of the Apartment is €148,000.
